column1: # One note per line: id, points, text, then key=value fields, split by tabs. Format: https://teoyujie.org/api/notes.txt

column3: Private home prices rose 1.4% in 3Q 2026, and more than 32,000 new units could go on sale within two years. Read it before you buy or sell a home.
For individual-owned private-hire car purchases signed from 30 Oct 2026, financing is capped at 60% or 70% of the price and seven years. Check the applicable limit before buying.
Employment grew by 27,700 in 3Q 2026, but retrenchments edged up in outward-oriented sectors. Check your own sector in the release before a job move.
From 1 Dec 2026, eligible patients can receive subsidised hereditary breast and ovarian cancer genetic testing. Ask your doctor to assess your risk and eligibility for referral.
Real median income grew 1.3% a year in 2019 to 2025, down from 3.4% in 2015 to 2019. Manufacturing output grew 5.0% a year while its resident jobs fell 1.3% a year. Nothing for a resident to do.
MOH does not require a medical practitioner to sign off on an insurer's medical-necessity refusal. Policyholders can take disputes over claims or pre-authorisation to FIDReC.
IMDA is studying how AI changes entry-level tech hiring. Students in tech courses can look at Bridge2Tech for work experience.

For Year of Assessment 2026, owners of two, three to four, and five or more residential properties declared net rental income of $1.7b, $0.9b and $0.4b respectively. The last figure may include some non-residential rent. Nothing for a resident to do.
Singapore has no plans to join the OECD scheme that shares property ownership data between tax authorities. Nothing for a resident to do.
The next $300 in CDC Vouchers is due in January 2027; Assurance Package cash is due in December 2026 for eligible Singaporeans. Check whether your June 2026 vouchers remain unspent.
The haze subsidy scheme ceased from 12 Nov 2026; the $10 cap for eligible patients no longer applies under that scheme. Nothing for a resident to do.
This consultation closed on 9 Nov 2026. It covers energy labels and minimum standards for washing machines, fans and dishwashers.
This matters only if you run or audit a co-operative.
This matters only if you run or audit a registered society.
The reply gives no data. It points to a written reply of 9 Sep 2026. Nothing for a resident to do.
If your transport spending is high, compare it with a monthly pass. The Public Transport Council and SimplyGo plan to notify commuters who may benefit based on past travel.
Eligible Singaporeans aged 21 or older in 2027 receive $100 to $250 from 8 Dec 2026. Check govbenefits.gov.sg; link PayNow-NRIC by 24 Nov for earlier payment.
For your Singapore checkpoint travel history, request it through ICA's website feedback channel. MHA says there is no current plan for MyICA self-service.
Households must apply for a Public Transport Voucher the first time so eligibility can be checked. Eligible households that received vouchers before may be paid automatically.
If you cannot pay your tax, apply to IRAS for a longer instalment plan beyond the standard 12-month interest-free GIRO plan.
If you received Workfare in the past year, check your eligibility for the Workfare Transport Concession Card. PTC is reviewing automatic applications; it has not announced implementation.
For substantial short-term care needs, check whether subsidised Home Personal Care or the Interim Caregiver Service applies to your situation.
From 2 Nov 2026, Police outgoing calls use 6000 0999, followed by a gov.sg SMS; the number cannot receive calls. Verify suspicious callers with Police through official channels.
Public accountants can apply via Bizfile from 1 Dec for 2027 registration and choose a one-, two- or three-year renewal. The renewal period ends on 31 Dec 2026.
CPF designated shares (the Singtel special discounted shares) move on 21 Nov 2026, and the transfer period runs 22 Nov to 7 Dec 2026. If you hold them, check your CDP account after that.
MOF takes views for Budget 2027 from 12 Nov 2026 to 6 Jan 2027, through go.gov.sg/mofbudget2027 or REACH. Send yours by 6 Jan if a Budget measure affects you.
MOH proposes guidelines on when young persons can get mental health services without parental consent. Give feedback at go.gov.sg/youth-mental-health-access by 8 Dec 2026, 6 pm.
This repeats the MOH consultation on young persons' access to mental health services. Read the MOH item.
From 16 Nov 2026, the cross-border taxi quota rises to 500 for each country, and CDG Zig and Kumpool join Grab as licensed operators. Compare them for trips to Malaysia.
From 13 Nov 2026, cyclists on roads must keep as near as practicable to the far left, and may ride two abreast only in set cases. Group riders must follow both rules.

Systems of AIC, Alliance Medinet, Doctor Anywhere, Fullerton Health, Minmed and Dementia Singapore's CARA app were accessed without authorisation. MOH knows of no access to patient health records. Nothing for a resident to do.
From 21 Nov 2026, a member may apply to withdraw shares held under the CPF scheme for approved corporations. It is part of the designated shares transfer; read the transfer order.
This only starts the CPF (Amendment) Act 2026 on 13 Nov 2026. The transfer order gives the dates that matter.
Technical changes for the designated shares transfer. The transfer order gives the dates that matter.
This matters only if you divide CPF assets in a divorce.
Bizfile and the VCC portal are down from 7 pm on 27 Nov to 4 am on 28 Nov 2026. This matters only if you file with ACRA then.
A road traffic exemption for chauffeured cars at the FinTech Festival, 14 to 23 Nov 2026. Nothing for a resident to do.
This defines sustainable aviation fuel by ICAO criteria from 15 Nov 2026. Nothing for a resident to do.
This starts one section of the Veterinary Practice Act on 16 Nov 2026. Nothing for a pet owner to do yet.
An account of a police investigation. Nothing for a resident to do.

NEA takes public views on its plans to redevelop Sarimbun Recycling Park, part of the former Lim Chu Kang Dumping Ground, from 18 Nov to 16 Dec 2026. Send yours at go.gov.sg/redevelopmentofsrp by 16 Dec if the site's effect on nature or nearby farms concerns you.

From 19 Nov 2026, solicitors can hold and pay out property sale money, including CPF money and stamp duty, through new digital conveyancing accounts. This matters only if you buy or sell property, and your lawyer handles it.
These rules set tax filing dates and steps when an insurer moves its insurance and other businesses to another company, backdated to 1 Nov 2021. Nothing for a resident to do.

From 18 Nov 2026, this caps Enterprise Innovation Scheme tax deductions and cash payouts for a company that takes over an insurer's businesses, so the two firms cannot claim the limits twice. Nothing for a resident to do.

MOM charged seven people and a company on 19 Nov 2026 for false declarations in work pass applications, including fake trainee passes and inflated salaries. Each charge carries a fine of up to $20,000, up to two years' jail, or both. Nothing for a resident to do.

More than 782,000 Singapore citizens born in 1976 or earlier get a CPF top-up of up to $1,500 by 8 Dec 2026 if their CPF savings were below $110,200 and their home's annual value was at most $31,000 at end-2025. It is paid automatically. Nothing for a resident to do.
From 21 Nov 2026, the Energy Market Authority can settle listed gas law offences with a fine instead of a court case. This matters only if you hold a gas licence or work on gas supply.

From 1 Dec 2026, CAAS sets new yearly charges for air navigation, weather, search and rescue and aeronautical information services, about $37 million for air traffic services. Nothing for a resident to do.

From 10 Dec 2026, Part B Bar exam candidates pay a $545 fee to withdraw, and a first sitting withdrawn before the first paper does not count as an attempt. This matters only if you are training to become a lawyer.
From 23 Nov 2026, the Health Sciences Authority's Enforcement Group is a named law enforcement agency that can get records under the Criminal Procedure Code. Nothing for a resident to do.
ERP charges drop from 23 Nov to 31 Dec 2026 at many gantries, and some time slots on the CTE, KPE, AYE, PIE and MCE become free. If you drive, you pay less ERP during the year-end school holidays.
From 21 Nov 2026, any licensed power generator with a gas-capable unit of 100 MW or more falls under Part 5B of the Electricity Act, except ExxonMobil and TP Utilities. Nothing for a resident to do.
URA closed the tender for the Town Hall Link site in Jurong Lake District on 17 Nov 2026, and has not yet awarded it. Nothing for a resident to do.

MOM charged 13 people for using phantom workers, who got CPF contributions but did not work, to raise firms' foreign worker quotas. Do not accept CPF money from a company you do not work for, as you can face a fine of up to $20,000, up to two years' jail, or both.
METI releases the Third Quarter 2026 Economic Survey of Singapore on 24 Nov 2026 at 8 am, with data on growth, inflation and jobs, on its website. Nothing for a resident to do.
From 19 Nov 2026, a digital signature made with the Sign with Singpass service counts as a secure electronic signature under the Electronic Transactions Act. Nothing for a resident to do.

From 19 Nov 2026, SLA sets rules for its electronic system for property deals, such as how users log in, how solicitors confirm payments, and how to fix typing errors. This matters only if you buy or sell registered land through a lawyer.

From 19 Nov 2026, you may still ride with a motorcycle helmet of the former SS 9:2014 type, whose police approval ended on 18 Nov 2026. Newer SS 9:2014 and SS 9:2024 helmets get the same exemption when their approval ends. This matters only if you ride a motorcycle.
From 19 Nov 2026, NEA sets rules under the haze law, including which banks and businesses are covered and that haze notices appear on haze.gov.sg. Nothing for a resident to do.
The Transboundary Haze Pollution (Amendment) Act 2026 comes into force on 19 Nov 2026. Nothing for a resident to do.
From 19 Nov 2026, MOH changes the list of clinics exempt under the Healthcare Services Act, updating the DTAP Clarke Quay address and removing one item. Nothing for a resident to do.
From 19 Nov 2026, CAAS is a named law enforcement agency that can get records under the Criminal Procedure Code. Nothing for a resident to do.
From 19 Nov 2026, the Prime Minister moves Part 2B of the Electronic Transactions Act to a different minister's portfolio. Nothing for a resident to do.
Parts 1 and 2 of the Electronic Conveyancing and Other Matters Act 2025 start on 19 Nov 2026. The notice does not say what those parts contain. Nothing for a resident to do.

PM Wong's op-ed ahead of the APEC meeting in Shenzhen on 19 Nov 2026 calls for open trade and closer Singapore-China ties. Singapore chairs ASEAN in 2027 and APEC in 2030. Nothing for a resident to do.

This Act widens the haze law to land or forest fires abroad that cause or risk haze here. The Minister can name firms or people and ban supplying, lending to or dealing with them. It starts on a date set later in the Gazette. This matters only if you do business with such firms.
Minister Grace Fu visited Istanbul and Mersin on 13 and 14 Nov 2026, and Singapore and Turkiye will set up a Joint Economic and Trade Committee. Nothing for a resident to do.
CTE (City) Exit 8A to PIE (Tuas) closes from 12am to 5am on 28 and 29 Nov and 16 to 19 Dec 2026. On those nights, use Exit 7C to Moulmein Road and Thomson Road to reach PIE (Tuas).
ASEAN signed the ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement at the economic ministers' meeting in Manila on 14 Nov 2026. Nothing for a resident to do.

Tote Board's Enhanced Fundraising Programme gave $240.94m in matching grants from FY2023 to FY2025. Charities with yearly receipts under $10m got 71% of it. This matters only if you run or raise funds for a charity.

Family doctors under Healthier SG, Community Health Posts and hospital discharge teams check when a senior's care needs change. Caregivers, including domestic helpers, can ask about the Caregivers Training Grant through AIC's website, hotline or an AIC Link.

Since 1 Oct 2026, etomidate vape reoffenders face more surprise urine and hair tests and faster admission to the Drug Rehabilitation Centre. People who seek help from IMH on their own face no penalty. Report vape sellers at go.gov.sg/reportvape or 6684 2036.
DPM Gan Kim Yong attends the 28th ASEAN Economic Community Council Meeting in Manila on 14 Nov 2026. Nothing for a resident to do.
Minister Josephine Teo met senior US officials in Washington on 12 and 13 Nov 2026 to discuss AI, quantum and cybersecurity. Nothing for a resident to do.
Singapore and Zambia signed a carbon credits agreement under the Paris Agreement at COP31 on 18 Nov 2026. It is Singapore's 14th such agreement. Nothing for a resident to do.

URA holds new focus groups on recreation and transport links for 'Long Island' from Jan 2027. Register at go.gov.sg/longisland2027engagements. Preparatory sea works start west of Bedok Jetty in Jan 2027, but East Coast Park beaches and paths stay open.

A US rule announced on 16 Nov 2026 needs a licence to send advanced chips to Singapore and four other countries, except to firms with US-based parent companies. The Government is studying it. This matters only if your company buys advanced chips.

Minister Josephine Teo spoke with US official Jeffrey Kessler on 17 Nov 2026 about the new US chip rule, and both sides will work on continued access for Singapore users. Nothing for a resident to do.

A former site manager got 49 days' jail for taking $18,000 in kickbacks from five migrant workers. Workers asked for kickbacks can call MOM at 6438 5122 or the Migrant Workers' Centre at 6536 2692. Report employers through MOM's Report an infringement eService.

ACRA's survey shows accountancy median pay rose in 2025, for example from $3,000 to $3,400 for a first-year audit assistant. Firms report over 1,200 job openings. This matters only if you work in or plan a career in accountancy.

A Bill introduced on 3 Nov 2026 tells courts to treat reformative training or jail as the default for scam and scam-enabling offenders aged 21 or below. It also applies to offences done before it starts. Giving your bank account, SIM card or Singpass to scammers is an offence.
The Home Team Festival runs at Suntec City Convention Centre until Sunday 22 Nov 2026, with live demonstrations and hands-on exhibits. This matters only if you can visit by 22 Nov.

A US rule announced on 16 Nov 2026 needs a licence to send advanced chips to Singapore and four other countries, except to firms with US-based parent companies. The Government is studying it. This matters only if your company buys advanced chips.
Singapore and Kenya signed a carbon credits agreement under the Paris Agreement at COP31 on 16 Nov 2026. It is Singapore's 13th such agreement. Nothing for a resident to do.
Minister Tan See Leng opened Mastercard's Asia Pacific innovation centre for AI and cybersecurity in Singapore on 12 Nov 2026. Nothing for a resident to do.
At the APEC meeting in Shenzhen on 19 Nov 2026, PM Wong urged open trade, flexible cooperation and practical gains such as paperless trade. Nothing for a resident to do.

MSE points to its 3 Nov oral answer. There, it says Climate Vouchers can already buy eligible DC fans with air-purifying functions, and free N95 masks go first to vulnerable groups such as CHAS Blue and Orange card holders. Nothing for a resident to do.

The MERCOSUR-Singapore Free Trade Agreement took effect with Argentina on 1 Nov 2026, so it is now in force with all four founding members. MERCOSUR will remove tariffs on about 96% of products over up to 15 years. This matters only if your business trades with South America.

METI and EMA launched three nuclear energy training schemes. The officer programme starts in 2027, and the industry programme funds staff of selected companies by invitation only. Singapore has not decided on nuclear energy. Nothing for a resident to do.

At Breakbulk Asia, the Minister of State said Enterprise Singapore supports 23 companies at the Singapore Pavilion, and Singapore port handled a record 44.66 million containers (TEUs) in 2025. Nothing for a resident to do.

DPM Gan announced three National AI Missions for financial services, including an industry-wide Scam Detection Utility, with an MAS design study starting early 2027. A new SGQR+ switch will let you pay any SGQR+ label with your preferred QR app. Nothing for a resident to do.

During the Sep to Oct 2026 haze, daily haze-related polyclinic visits rose about 25% (4,000 to 5,000) and emergency visits about 20%. Visits fell after the Haze Subsidy Scheme started on 12 Oct. Nothing for a resident to do.

After the 2026 fare review, 7.7% of deferred fare increases remain to be passed on. Taxpayers cover any part not passed to commuters. The Public Transport Council will keep reducing it at a pace that considers affordability. Nothing for a resident to do.

Singapore has 15 passenger autonomous vehicles in Punggol and expects a few hundred by end-2028. They do not need COEs for now, so MOT says they do not affect COE demand or prices. Nothing for a resident to do.

The Public Transport Council reviews the fare formula every five years, and the next review is due by 2028. MOT will not link fares to operator performance or put a time limit on deferred fare increases. Nothing for a resident to do.

As of 26 Oct 2026, more than 650 overnight parking arrangements for heavy vehicles were lodged with LTA under the scheme that started on 15 Sep 2026. Most failed lodgements were duplicate or incomplete. This matters only if you own a heavy vehicle.

MOM is investigating about 45 Changi Airport companies, covering about 270 workers, for false work pass declarations and illegal deployment. A false declaration carries a fine of up to $20,000, jail of up to two years, or both. Report suspected cases through MOM's Report an Infringement eService.

MINDEF is looking at better NS Housing, Medical and Education Awards for NSmen, with details in 2027. For caregivers, new Caregiver Support Touchpoints start in 2027 to connect them to respite, training and money support. Nothing for a resident to do.

MOT says it already answered these questions on the planned merger of COE Categories A and B and the fee-and-rebate system at the 3 Nov 2026 sitting. This reply gives no new figures. Nothing for a resident to do.

SIT and CEVA Logistics opened a joint lab to test robotics and AI vision in warehouses over five years. A Logistics Jobs Transformation Map will come out in 2027 to show the skills workers will need. Nothing for a resident to do.

The Accounting Standards Committee issued new standards on regulatory assets and liabilities on 5 Nov 2026, effective for periods starting on or after 1 Jan 2029. This matters only if you prepare or audit company accounts.
Since 2024, only two shipping companies, under 1% of those that qualify, chose to be taxed on the net tonnage basis. This matters only if you run a shipping business.

More than 150 scam victims each year in 2024 and 2025 got support from the Police Victim Care Cadre Programme. Victims who accept support can give feedback to their Victim Care Officer. Nothing for a resident to do.

As of 31 Aug 2026, about 1,700 of 11,642 undischarged bankrupts were still listed as directors of live companies, but they may not manage those companies. You can check a director's status in the ACRA Business Profile or People Profile. Nothing else for a resident to do.

From 1 Jan 2027, the yearly MediSave limit for outpatient chronic disease treatment rises from $500 to $700, or from $700 to $1,000 for complex conditions. If you are 60 or older, Flexi-MediSave adds up to $400 a year for outpatient bills.

Lower-income households spent 2.4% of their income on public transport in each of the past three years. Fewer than 1 in 20 spent more than 5%, says the 2023 Household Expenditure Survey. Nothing for a resident to do.

Since Oct 2026, telcos suspend the local mobile lines of work permit holders who have left Singapore after their job ended. Banks have suspended such holders' accounts since June 2024. This matters only if you employ or are a work permit holder.

MOT says it answered these questions on end-buyer approval of COE bids and the impact of merging COE Categories A and B at the 3 Nov 2026 sitting. This reply gives no new figures. Nothing for a resident to do.

In 2023, the bottom 10% of working households paid about 6% of their income on healthcare after subsidies, insurance and MediSave, and the bottom 40% paid about 5%. If you cannot pay a hospital bill, ask the medical social worker there about MediFund.

MOT will not tie fares to operator profits. Bus fare revenue does not go to bus operators, and most rail operators' profits are capped at about 5%. Operators pay part of each fare rise into a fund for Public Transport Vouchers. Nothing for a resident to do.

ACRA guidance lists six areas for directors and Audit Committees to check in FY2026 financial statements, such as impairment, credit losses and going concern. This matters only if you sit on a company board or Audit Committee.

The Haze Subsidy Scheme ran from 12 Oct to 12 Nov 2026, with over 41,000 polyclinic and 72,000 GP visits by 24 Oct. Citizens aged 19 to 64 got it at GP clinics only with a CHAS Blue or Orange, Medical Fee Exemption or Public Assistance card. Nothing for a resident to do.
STB sees more demand for personalised tours and runs Future of Guiding 2.0, with new training and new licence renewal rules for guides. This matters only if you are a licensed tourist guide.

Prepayment losses reported to CASE were $476,000 in 2023, $1.93 million in 2024 and $2.71 million in 2025, with over 2,500 consumers hit in 2024 and 2025. A review panel will publish its advice later this year. Nothing for a resident to do.

URA's 99-year housing site at Orchard Boulevard drew five bids when its tender closed on 29 Oct 2026. The top bid was $181.9 million, or $18,891 per square metre of floor area. URA has not awarded it yet. Nothing for a resident to do.
ACRA guidance tells auditors what to check when they audit digital assets, such as private keys, smart contracts and token prices. This matters only if you are an auditor.
New Zealand, Korea and Singapore marked progress in talks on a Green Economy Partnership Agreement on 5 Nov 2026. Nothing for a resident to do.

From 1 Mar 2027, children and adults with Type 1 diabetes who meet clinical criteria can get subsidies for advanced hybrid closed-loop systems, which link glucose monitors to insulin pumps. This matters only if you or your child has Type 1 diabetes.
Mr Alvin Moh becomes Chief Executive of HTX and an MHA Deputy Secretary on 1 Feb 2027. Mr Chan Tsan becomes Chief Executive of LTA on 1 May 2027. Nothing for a resident to do.
ACRA guidance helps audit firms improve their quality management systems, mainly risk assessment, monitoring and fixing problems. This matters only if you work at an audit firm.

URA gave 2026 Architectural Heritage Awards to three projects, including 21 Carpenter Street and the Church of Our Lady of Lourdes. An exhibition at The URA Centre shows the winners. Nothing for a resident to do.
Singapore opened its pavilion at the COP31 climate conference in Antalya on 10 Nov 2026, with over 60 programmes over two weeks. Nothing for a resident to do.
URA opened two Reserve List housing sites for application on 27 Oct 2026: Chuan Grove, with about 930 homes, and Plymouth Avenue/Dunearn Road, with about 250 homes. Nothing for a resident to do.
Ms Grace Fu said Singapore, as ASEAN chair in 2027, will focus on food supply, with half a billion dollars of blended finance for small farmers. Nothing for a resident to do.
Enterprise Singapore will roll out the EDGE Grant, which combines several business support schemes, including help with digitalisation and AI. This matters only if you run a business.

MOF will not waive ABSD for foreigners who must buy a replacement home after a collective sale. All buyers pay ABSD by residency and the number of homes they own. This matters only if you are a foreigner or own several homes and your estate is sold en bloc.

In October 2026, about 12,000 Singapore vehicles that need an ERP 2.0 On-Board Unit still had none, and 90% were cars and motorcycles. The work to remove or change 95 ERP gantries costs about $6 million. This matters only if your vehicle has no On-Board Unit yet.

A firm that sells corporate services in Singapore must register with ACRA, even if an overseas firm does the work. ACRA has found no such unregistered case since 9 Jun 2025. This matters only if you run a corporate service business.

Police will not use AI to translate statements yet, because current tools miss mixed languages and slang. A statement is read back in a language the person understands before they sign it. Nothing for a resident to do.
Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever, Lassa fever and Marburg virus disease became legally notifiable diseases from 31 Oct 2026. MOH says the risk to Singapore stays low. Nothing for a resident to do.

Singapore and Zambia signed a carbon credit agreement under Article 6 of the Paris Agreement on 18 Nov 2026. Singapore companies can use credits from Zambian projects under the carbon tax. Nothing for a resident to do.

Domestic waste per person per day fell about 21% over ten years. MSE is reviewing the Zero Waste Masterplan, and Singapore and Türkiye will recognise each other's ecolabels. Nothing for a resident to do.

MOH is consulting the public on proposed guidelines on parental consent for young people who seek mental health services. The consultation is open until 8 Dec 2026. Send your views by 8 Dec if you are a parent, a young person or a practitioner.

Singapore will publish its first National Adaptation Plan for climate change in 2027. In 2025, public healthcare institutions used 7.9% less energy per square metre than the baseline. Nothing for a resident to do.
MOT gives no new facts on the North-South Corridor delays here. The Minister says he answered the questions at the 6 Oct 2026 sitting. Nothing for a resident to do.
MOT gives no new facts on autonomous ride-hailing from 2028 here. The Minister refers to his written reply to Oral Questions 30 to 33 at the 7 Oct 2026 sitting. Nothing for a resident to do.

MSF-supervised welfare homes have no standing arrangements with their healthcare clusters for social prescribing today. MOH says it will keep working with MSF on better access to health programmes. Nothing for a resident to do.

MSF already shares gambling exclusion order data with gambling operators in real time. The Gambling Regulatory Authority checks operators through audits and spot-checks. This matters only if you or a family member has an exclusion order.
MOT gives no new facts on COE affordability or the proposed COE category changes here. The Minister says the questions were answered at the 3 Nov 2026 sitting. Nothing for a resident to do.

The Eastern General Hospital campus will open in stages from 2029. Changi General Hospital will add about 160 acute beds by 2027, and St Andrew's Community Hospital in Bedok has run 240 more beds since end-2025. This matters only if you live in the East.
The electricity market's Required Reserve Margin is reviewed at least once every five years. The next review is in 2030. Nothing for a resident to do.

The new faster clinical psychology pathway keeps the same curriculum and training. Clinical psychologists will be regulated under the Allied Health Professions Act, with the requirements to be announced in early 2027. This matters only if you study or practise clinical psychology.

In the National Population Health Survey 2023/2024, 12.7% of residents aged 18 to 74 had obesity. MOH has no data on how many people are in weight management programmes or how long they wait. Nothing for a resident to do.
49% of seniors aged 60 and above spend one to two hours a day on leisure on their devices, and 38% spend three to five hours. MOH will keep watching the research. Nothing for a resident to do.

Close to 3,000 F&B outlets are in the Return Right F&B Scheme, so diners there pay no 10-cent drink container deposit and leave the empty container. The deposit scheme was fully in place from 1 Oct 2026. Nothing for a resident to do.
The Government already publishes resident income, Gross National Income and related figures on the Department of Statistics website. Nothing for a resident to do.

Since Sept 2022, the Energy Efficiency Grant has approved close to 25,000 projects worth $78 million for about 8,300 companies. Solar panels are not covered. This matters only if you run a business that buys energy-efficient equipment.

Police do not track how many seniors use self-help kiosks. At a kiosk, you can talk to a Police officer by video call, and the officer can lodge the report for you if needed. Manned counters remain at some locations. Nothing for a resident to do.

If your household has high commuting costs, you can apply for extra Public Transport Vouchers online or at your Community Centre or Club. Officers will consider your household's situation and transport needs.

Police do not track whether people warned by SMS under Project A.S.T.R.O. later lost money to scams. In the first half of 2026, Police and banks alerted over 9,180 possible scam victims. Nothing for a resident to do.

MSE gave no new answer here on the four 2015 haze investigations. It points to its combined reply of 3 Nov 2026 and the Transboundary Haze Pollution (Amendment) Bill debate on 4 Nov 2026. Nothing for a resident to do.
The 2026 fare review used diesel and electricity prices from July 2025 to June 2026. The recent fall in electricity tariffs will count only in the 2027 fare review. Nothing for a resident to do.

At COP31, Singapore said its carbon tax rose from S$25 to S$45 per tonne this year and will reach S$50 to S$80 by 2030. Its first National Adaptation Plan comes out in 2027. Nothing for a resident to do.

At COP31, Singapore launched the Singapore Green Cooperation Programme and gave US$500,000 to the Pacific Resilience Facility. Its first National Adaptation Plan is being developed. Nothing for a resident to do.

The 2-year reoffending rate for Malays released in 2023 fell to 27%, from 34.5% for those released in 2012. FITRAH will pilot a Mosque Care aftercare model for ex-offenders next year. This matters only if you support ex-offenders or their families.

CSA, GovTech and IMDA advised people not to give general-purpose AI agents broad access to banking, government or healthcare accounts. MAS is testing checks on AI agent payments. Nothing for a resident to do.

Singapore will publish its first National Adaptation Plan in 2027 and named 2026 the Year of Climate Adaptation. This COP31 event covered heat, cooling, adaptation finance, food and water. Nothing for a resident to do.

About 243 million people in Southeast Asia's six largest economies use generative AI. The National AI Impact Programme helps firms, including SMEs, use AI in their work. This matters only if you run a business that wants to adopt AI.

The Johor Bahru-Singapore RTS Link can carry up to 10,000 passengers an hour each way. The operator is still running system tests and needs a safety certificate and approval from both countries. MOT gave no ridership forecast. Nothing for a resident to do.

From 2021 to 2024, up to 5% of IVF cycles at public centres were stopped, mostly due to poor results or patient choice. MOH does not track later pregnancies. This matters only if you are undergoing IVF.

The most common issues raised on national mindline 1771, including by adults aged 20 to 35, are emotional needs, anxiety and burnout, and relationship problems. The pattern is the same on the hotline, WhatsApp and webchat. Nothing for a resident to do.

From 2020 to 2024, about 23% of women who tried IVF had a live birth within the six co-funded cycles. About 1% (197) used all six without one, and 32 later had a live birth with self-funded treatment. This matters only if you are undergoing IVF.

There is no CASE-like agency for self-employed persons. MTI points them to the Small Claims Tribunals for claims up to $30,000, and to legal aid, pro bono and legal clinic services such as Pro Bono SG. This matters only if you are self-employed and have a business dispute.

Since December 2024, 10 of 29 licensed EV charging operators missed the monthly uptime rule of 90%. LTA took no action for these early problems but may impose fines in future. HDB carpark chargers must meet a higher standard. This matters only if you drive an EV.

In 2025 and 2026, about 75% of NHG Health specialist outpatient patients were discharged back to their Healthier SG enrolled clinic. Other clusters do not yet have figures. Nothing for a resident to do.

Since 2023, the fare formula uses a fixed 0.1% Productivity Contribution to lower fare rises. The Public Transport Council will review this in its next fare formula review, due by 2028. Nothing for a resident to do.

MOH says no rule stops preschools from using okara under the Healthy Meals in Preschools Programme. Such foods can go in meals if they give protein and are part of a balanced diet. Nothing for a resident to do.
MOH does not track whether people find jobs after help from Community Intervention Teams (COMIT) for mental health. Nothing for a resident to do.

LTA has closed its COE review consultation and has not decided the outcome yet. LTA will review lower COE bid fees for individuals and a rule for dealers to show car prices without COE. MOT is studying a transport grant for large families. Nothing for a resident to do.

In 2025, each Sengkang Polyclinic doctor saw 22% more patients than doctors at polyclinics in other towns, and each staff member 13% more. MOH is looking at ways to add capacity there. This matters only if you use Sengkang Polyclinic.
This Bill gives MPA more powers over wrecks, new port technology, cybersecurity and licensees in Singapore waters. This matters only if you work in the maritime or port sector.

Of 93 GovTech officers in the first retrenchment phase, 36 left in Aug 2026. By 30 Oct 2026, 11 of them had new jobs and 14 were getting job search help. This matters only if you are an affected GovTech officer.

SCDF publishes the causes of all home fires in its yearly fire statistics. In 2025, the top three causes were unattended cooking, electrical faults and open flames such as candles. Nothing for a resident to do.

HSA has approved no magnetic therapy chairs for medical use and has warned a company about false health claims. If you have a dispute over buying such a chair, you can ask the Consumers Association of Singapore (CASE) for help.
To get the Morning Pre-Peak Discount, enter the train network before 7.45am. The fare gate shows if your trip qualifies when you tap in. MOT will look at ways to tell more commuters about it.
MOF says claims that GIC and Temasek pushed MSCI to downgrade Indonesia's stock market are false. Nothing for a resident to do.
MOH is writing rules for osteoporosis risk checks and bone density screening under Healthier SG, by age and gender. It will announce details later. Nothing for a resident to do.

IRAS's operating surplus fell to $8.0 million in FY2025/26, mainly because it runs old and new tax IT systems together during an upgrade. Its cost per dollar of tax collected was 0.63 cents in FY2025. Nothing for a resident to do.

For 2026, the Public Transport Council (PTC) raised fares by 7.0%, less than half the maximum of 14.7%, and cut the deferred fare amount by 1.7%. The PTC will review the whole fare formula before the 2028 fare review. Nothing for a resident to do.

This speech closes the debate on the MPA (Amendment) Bill. CAAS stays the lead regulator for drones, and MPA will work with it on drones in the port. This matters only if you work in the maritime or port sector.

MOH subsidises genetic tests for familial high cholesterol since 2025, and will subsidise tests for hereditary breast and ovarian cancer from later in 2026. This matters only if you or your family have these conditions.

From 30 Oct 2026, car loans for individual-owned private hire cars follow the same rules as other private cars: a loan of at most 70% of the price if the OMV is $20,000 or less, 60% if more, and a term of at most 7 years. This matters only if you plan to buy a car to drive for private hire.

Singapore and China signed a transport cooperation agreement that covers the movement of goods and people, green shipping corridors and transport technology. A joint ministers' committee will meet every two years. Nothing for a resident to do.
China's Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang visits Singapore on 22 and 23 Nov 2026 to co-chair the yearly Joint Council for Bilateral Cooperation with DPM Gan Kim Yong. Nothing for a resident to do.

At COP31, Minister Grace Fu spoke on the Global Cooling Pledge and the next steps on heat resilience and sustainable cooling that came out of the Assembly Singapore hosted in September. Nothing for a resident to do.

Minister Josephine Teo said Singapore is studying the new US limits on chip sales to Singapore, and that its investigation into the company Megaspeed is still ongoing. She also said Singapore cannot allow unlimited growth in data centres. Nothing for a resident to do.

At COP31, 16 countries signed the Antalya Statement to support high-integrity carbon credit markets. Singapore already gives companies a 100% corporate tax deduction for spending on voluntary carbon credits. This matters only if you run a company that buys carbon credits.

Singapore and Kenya signed an agreement under Article 6 of the Paris Agreement to trade carbon credits from projects in Kenya. Applications for projects open in 2027. This matters only if you run a business that develops or buys carbon credit projects.

MOF will not give foreigners a lower additional buyer's stamp duty (ABSD) for one-bedroom homes. The same ABSD rules apply to all types of homes, and the rates depend on your residency status and how many homes you own. Nothing for a resident to do.

As of Oct 2026, LTA lists 106 battery models from 77 manufacturers that work with compliant power-assisted bicycles, personal mobility devices and mobility scooters. This matters only if you need a new battery for one of these devices.
Nearly 1,000 Home Team officers received National Day Awards in 2026, and the minister spoke on how Singapore equips its officers against drug syndicates. Nothing for a resident to do.

MediSave can already pay up to $900 of pre-delivery medical bills, such as consultations and scans. You claim it by giving these bills to the hospital where your baby is delivered. MOH will study letting parents use MediSave when each bill is incurred.

MOM charged LBD Engineering and its General Manager on 29 Oct 2026 for housing 173 migrant workers in an unlicensed dormitory at 58A Sungei Kadut Loop. The offence carries a fine of up to $500,000, up to two years in jail, or both. Nothing for a resident to do.

Parliament passed the Digital Infrastructure Act in Oct 2026. It sets security, resilience and sustainability rules for major data centres and cloud providers, with transition periods. This matters only if you run a data centre or cloud service.

Minister Josephine Teo told US companies that Singapore, as ASEAN Chair in 2027, will start a programme called ASEAN AI for All. It will cover AI adoption, AI assurance and cross-border data flows. Nothing for a resident to do.

Traffic Police will start a Junior Road Safety Ambassador programme for upper primary student leaders, and a Road Safety Bus will visit schools from the second half of 2027. The Road Safety Community Park will be redeveloped. This matters only if you have children in primary school.
Minister Grace Fu visits Türkiye from 13 to 21 Nov 2026 for trade meetings and the COP31 climate talks in Antalya. Nothing for a resident to do.

URA awarded the 99-year residential site at Orchard Boulevard to Intrepid Investments and TID Residential for $181.86 million, or $18,891 per square metre of floor area. This matters only if you follow private home land prices.
PM Lawrence Wong visits Shenzhen for the APEC leaders' meeting on 18 to 19 Nov 2026 and Beijing on 20 to 21 Nov. DPM Gan Kim Yong is Acting PM while he is away. Nothing for a resident to do.

Public hospitals and polyclinics prescribe GLP-1 weight-loss medicines to about 1,000 patients a year. The Agency for Care Effectiveness is reviewing their cost-effectiveness, and that review will decide any subsidy. Nothing for a resident to do.

MOT will consider letting residents of dense towns such as Sengkang park tall commercial vehicles overnight on suitable road bridges. It will weigh safety, traffic and noise first. This matters only if you own or drive a tall commercial vehicle.
NEA issued notices to quit to about 180 hawker stallholders from 2021 to 2025 for not running their stalls in person after earlier warnings. This matters only if you hold or sublet a hawker stall.

MDDI says AI agents that copy themselves across devices may add risk, but existing safeguards still apply. CSA's Cybersecurity Labelling Scheme shows which smart devices are more secure. Nothing for a resident to do.

Haze caused no flight disruptions at Changi, but about 300 Seletar Airport flights were delayed, diverted or cancelled since 5 Oct 2026, including about 160 Firefly flights to Subang. This matters only if you fly from Seletar.

LTA has stopped plans to run autonomous buses on public services 400 and 191. It will use all six buses, from an $8.14 million contract, for narrower uses such as staff shuttles. Nothing for a resident to do.
MSE did not answer these questions on support for hawkers hit by the October 2026 haze here. It points to its oral answers in Parliament on 3 Nov 2026. Nothing for a resident to do.
MOH has no plans to let clinical psychologists prescribe medicine. Psychologists refer patients who need medicine to psychiatrists or family doctors. Nothing for a resident to do.
MTI says scenarios in the ASEAN Energy Outlook are for analysis only and are not national positions. Singapore stays committed to net-zero emissions by 2050. Nothing for a resident to do.
SingPost's digital stamp trial lets you buy stamps in its app. Physical stamps stay on sale, and there are no plans to phase them out for now. Nothing for a resident to do.

NLB will end The Little Book Box delivery service from 1 Apr 2027. From Jan 2027, families with children aged six and below can join NLB's free A Book A Day reading programme. This matters only if you subscribe to The Little Book Box.

MDDI says Singapore is building AI testing skills through the AI Verify Foundation's AI Tester Accreditation Programme and a proposed ISO standard for testing generative AI. Nothing for a resident to do.

CSA sets risk-based deadlines for critical infrastructure owners to report on fixing critical security flaws, with faster ones for internet-facing or actively exploited flaws. Nothing for a resident to do.

MFA told Iran of Singapore's serious concerns after attacks on Singapore-registered ships in the Strait of Hormuz, and MPA issues security advisories to ship operators. This matters only if you work on or run Singapore-flagged ships.
